description: Plan each shield move around the player's next usable input. BxB connects handoffs and reuse; BxC combines joint delivery, separate preparation and a later approach.
steps: Work backward from the exit to a useful shield operation and its reachable input side.
Choose how the next tool is prepared, how it travels, and how the player continues after using it.
Keep parked tools usable for their later roles; release them through a verified route to the goal.
exampleDescription: A separately verified authored realization of tool preparation, usable input access and release.
